description: Authentication System: Create the login page, logout route, auth callback, user hook, and header component
steps: Create src/app/login/page.tsx - client component with dark-themed login form
Create src/app/auth/callback/route.ts - handles auth callback for Supabase
Create src/app/logout/route.ts - server route that signs out and redirects to /login
Create src/hooks/useUser.ts - custom hook for current user and profile
acceptance_criteria: Login page renders with email/password fields and submit button
Auth callback route exchanges code for session
Logout route signs out and redirects
useUser hook provides user and profile data
Header shows app name, user info, and logout button
npm run build completes without errors
verification: Run npm run build and confirm successful compilation with zero errors
findings: All auth system files created successfully. Login page is a client component with signInWithPassword. Auth callback route uses createServerClient directly (same pattern as server.ts) to exchange code for session. Logout route uses the server createClient helper. useUser hook provides user + profile with auth state change listener. Header component uses useUser hook and displays app branding, user avatar/name/role badge, and logout link. Build passes cleanly with no errors. The middleware deprecation warning about proxy is pre-existing from FEAT-001.
